meta.name: citation-management
meta.description: Comprehensive citation management for academic research. Search OpenAlex, PubMed, and Google Scholar for papers, extract accurate metadata, validate citations, and generate properly formatted BibTeX entries. This skill should be used when you need to find papers, verify citation information, convert DOIs to BibTeX, or ensure reference accuracy in scientific writing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检索学术文献并生成规范参考文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果平时需要大量检索和引用学术文献
copy.tagline_en: Find papers and generate correctly formatted citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently search and cite academic literature

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能帮你查找论文、核对引用信息、把 DOI 等编号转成 BibTeX 条目;还会自动补全缺失的元数据,并格式化、去重、校验 BibTeX 文件,文档里也可配示意图。
howto.when: 当你提到查找论文、把 DOI/PMID 等转成 BibTeX、核实引用或整理参考文献等需求时触发。

say.text: 把这个 DOI 转成 BibTeX:10.1000/xyz123
say.note: 会生成一条规范的 BibTeX 引用条目。

say.text: 在 Google Scholar 搜‘CRISPR 基因编辑’近五年的高引论文
say.note: 会调用搜索脚本,返回匹配的论文列表。

say.text: 校验这份 references.bib,补全缺失的卷号页码
say.note: 会先联网检索缺失信息,再更新 BibTeX 条目。

howto.what_en: Claude can find papers, verify citation details, convert DOIs and other IDs into BibTeX entries, fill missing metadata automatically, and format, deduplicate, and validate BibTeX files. It can also add diagrams to documents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to find papers, convert DOIs or other identifiers to BibTeX, verify or clean references, or build a bibliography.

say_en.text: Search Google Scholar for highly cited CRISPR papers from the last five years.
say_en.note: Runs the search script and returns a paper list.

say_en.text: Validate this references.bib and fill in missing volume and page numbers.
say_en.note: Fetches missing metadata online, then updates the entries.
